# CBS News

> > CBS News delivers breaking news, investigative reporting, and comprehensive coverage across U.S., world, politics, entertainment, health, crime, and space topics.

CBS News is a major broadcast journalism outlet providing real-time news updates, live coverage of major events, and in-depth reporting on geopolitical crises, domestic policy, and cultural events. The site emphasizes breaking news, live updates, and investigative journalism across multiple news verticals.

## Key Topics

- Iran-Israel conflict
- Breaking news
- Live updates
- Trump administration
- Middle East geopolitics
- Energy crisis
- Pentagon spending
- Military strikes
- War escalation
- Defense budget
- Investigative reporting
- South Pars gas field
- U.S. Central Command
- Hospice fraud
- F-35

## News Hubs

- [CBS News Home](https://www.cbsnews.com): CBS News homepage with breaking news, top stories and latest headlines
- [U.S. News](https://www.cbsnews.com/us): U.S. news hub with daily breaking news and top stories from CBS News
- [World News](https://www.cbsnews.com/world): Global news hub with daily breaking news and world stories from CBS News
- [Politics News](https://www.cbsnews.com/politics): Politics news hub covering elections, policies and Trump administration

## Breaking News & Live Coverage

- [Iran-Israel Conflict Live Updates](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-israel-strike-south-pars-gas-field-trump-threat-oil-gas-prices): Live coverage of Iran-Israel conflict and South Pars gas field strike impact on energy prices and geopolitical tensions

## Investigative Reporting

- [Hospice Fraud Investigation](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hospice-fraud-investigation-los-angeles-office-plaza): Investigation into hospice fraud clustering in Los Angeles office plaza with state records analysis

## Specialty Coverage

- [Entertainment News](https://www.cbsnews.com/entertainment): Entertainment news hub with celebrity, movies, TV, music and awards coverage
- [HealthWatch](https://www.cbsnews.com/healthwatch): CBS News HealthWatch hub covering health policy, vaccines and health news
- [Crime News](https://www.cbsnews.com/crime): Crime news hub with daily updates on crime, corruption and scandals
- [Space News](https://www.cbsnews.com/space): Space news hub with coverage of space exploration and discoveries
